name: Harbor House Inn

menus.name: Full Experience tasting menu
menus.note: Thursday to Monday, seatings at 5:30pm, 6pm and 6:45pm; changes daily; drinks pairings from $125

menus.name: five-course lunch
menus.note: Thursday to Monday, seatings at 12pm, 12:30pm and 1pm; changes daily

hotel: the Harbor House Inn, an 11-room inn on the Mendocino coast
bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable; reservations are required. Each month's tables are released to the public on the 1st of the month before. Inn guests who book a room well ahead get earlier access, and a few tables are held for inn guests.

bookingWindow.note: Inn guests booking ahead get earlier access.

cancellation: Bookings are charged on the day, including no-shows. Dinner can be cancelled up to 72 hours ahead and lunch up to 24 hours ahead; cancellations inside those windows are not refunded.
waitlist: Join the waiting list on OpenTable.
groups: Private dinners, weddings and events for up to 60, which need all 11 rooms and cottages booked. Enquiries to events@theharborhouseinn.com.
dressCode: No t-shirts, shorts, flip-flops, sportswear or hats; jackets and ties are not required. Guests are asked not to wear perfume or cologne.

stay.name: Harbor House Inn
stay.note: Six rooms in the main house and five cottages on the Mendocino coast, each stay with breakfast; the inn holds a few dinner tables for guests who book rooms.
